_help: One entry per rating scale (e.g., one per sense). Add to work/scales/all2.json AND add the matching coding entry (below) to facets/coded2.json.

scale_entry.wording: <exact instruction wording if printed; otherwise a summary>
scale_entry.anchors: <e.g., 0-5; 0 = not experienced at all, 5 = experienced greatly>
scale_entry.dk: <yes ("Don't know the meaning of this word" box) | not stated>
scale_entry.wtype: <verbatim (printed in paper) | verbatim (translation printed in paper) | paraphrase / summary (exact wording not printed or not checked)>

coding_entry.R: <R code, see Code key sheet of the table>
coding_entry._help: set catN to core (or border) for each category 1-6 the scale belongs to: 1 global sensory experience, 2 experience per sense, 3 perceptual features, 4 bodily involvement (no body part named), 5 specific body part / effector, 6 body-object interaction
